description: This source file contains unit tests for the Orleans streaming storage layer using relational databases such as SQL Server, MySQL, and PostgreSQL. It defines several test classes that verify queuing, dequeuing, confirmation, and dead letter handling for stream messages within a relational storage system.

classes.name: SqlServerRelationalOrleansQueriesTests
classes.description: Test class for SQL Server relational Orleans queries, inherits from RelationalOrleansQueriesTests, specific to SQL Server invariant.

classes.name: MySqlRelationalOrleansQueriesTests
classes.description: Test class for MySQL relational Orleans queries, inherits from RelationalOrleansQueriesTests, specific to MySQL invariant.

classes.name: PostgreSqlRelationalOrleansQueriesTests
classes.description: Test class for PostgreSQL relational Orleans queries, inherits from RelationalOrleansQueriesTests, specific to PostgreSQL invariant.

classes.name: RelationalOrleansQueriesTests
classes.description: Abstract base class defining common tests for Orleans streaming relational storage layer, parameterized by database invariant.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Sets up the test instance, including database connection and storage initialization.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Async disposal pattern; currently a no-op.

methods.description: Generates a random service ID string.

methods.name: RandomProviderId
methods.description: Generates a random provider ID string.

methods.name: RandomQueueId
methods.description: Generates a random queue ID string.

methods.name: RandomExpiryTimeout
methods.description: Generates a random expiry timeout value.

methods.name: RandomPayload
methods.description: Creates a byte array payload with specified size filled with random bytes.

methods.name: RelationalOrleansQueries_QueuesMessage
methods.description: Tests queuing a single message.

methods.name: RelationalOrleansQueries_QueuesManyMessagesInParallel
methods.description: Tests queuing many messages concurrently.

methods.name: RelationalOrleansQueries_QueuesManyMessagesInParallelOnManyQueues
methods.description: Tests queuing messages across multiple queues in parallel.

methods.name: RelationalOrleansQueries_DequeuesSingleMessage
methods.description: Tests dequeuing a single message.

methods.name: RelationalOrleansQueries_DequeuesMessageBatches
methods.description: Tests dequeuing messages in batch sizes.

methods.name: RelationalOrleansQueries_DequeuesSingleMessageAgainAfterVisibilityTimeout
methods.description: Tests re-dequeuing a message after visibility timeout expires.

methods.name: RelationalOrleansQueries_DoesNotDequeueSingleMessageBeforeVisibilityTimeout
methods.description: Verifies message is not dequeued before visibility timeout.

methods.name: RelationalOrleansQueries_DoesNotDequeueSingleMessageAfterExpiry
methods.description: Verifies message is not dequeued after its expiry time.

methods.name: RelationalOrleansQueries_ConfirmsMessages
methods.description: Tests confirming messages and their removal from storage.

methods.name: RelationalOrleansQueries_DoesNotConfirmMessagesWithWrongReceipt
methods.description: Ensures messages are not confirmed if the receipt does not match.

methods.name: RelationalOrleansQueries_ConfirmsSomeMessagesAndNotOthers
methods.description: Partial message confirmation in a mixed scenario, ensuring correct handling.

methods.name: RelationalOrleansQueries_ChaosTest
methods.description: Performs concurrent, stress testing for enqueueing, dequeuing, confirming, and eviction operations to detect deadlocks and race conditions.

methods.name: RelationalOrleansQueries_MovesPoisonedMessageToDeadLetters
methods.description: Checks that poisoned messages are correctly moved to dead letter storage.

methods.name: RelationalOrleansQueries_DoesNotMoveHealthyMessageToDeadLetters
methods.description: Verifies healthy messages are not incorrectly moved to dead letters.

methods.name: Randomize
methods.description: Shuffles an enumerable collection into a randomized list.
